Hi Erin —

Appreciate the time on the demo today. Per our discussion, attached is a formal pilot proposal that pairs the Hosted API with a 12-month ramp commitment. Highlights:

- 25% usage discount for months 1–12 (applies to text-generation token spend)
- Minimum committed spend: $200,000 over 12 months

This price is intended to cover your Proof-of-Value and first-stage production split across two regions. The discount requires executive authorization on our side because it exceeds the standard 15% SDR concession. Could you confirm if Ventura Health can sign a simple SOW + PO within 10 business days if we get internal approval?

Kimberly —

Thanks for the proposal and the neat summary. 25% would be compelling for us given the scale we expect after the pilot. A couple of quick clarifying Qs from the procurement side before we route a PO:

1) Is the discount fixed for the full 12 months or volume-tiered?
2) Are there any data residency/KMS requirements we need to surface to legal?
3) Can you confirm the minimum commitment is refundable or credit-only if we do not consume?

If you can answer those, procurement will prepare a PO template. We are targeting an Oct 1 start for the pilot.

Ben / Mina —

Looping you in. Ventura likes the 25% ask and procurement has started the PO questions (see below). This would be a strategic new logo in the payer-provider cohort and strong reference for our healthcare playbook. Quick deal economics below (see attached model):

- Forecasted total ARR (12mo): $750k (conservative)
- Commit: $200k guaranteed first-year spend
- Incremental churn risk: low (integrated workflow + pilot-to-prod path)
- Margin impact at 25%: ~9% reduction in blended gross margin for year 1; payback via usage growth/market expansion in year 2

Ask: approval for a 25% Hosted API discount for months 1–12 with standard T&Cs (no additional IP concessions). We will require a VP-level signoff for anything >20% per policy. If approved, I will send redlined SOW and engage legal to confirm the KMS/data residency clauses requested by their legal team (Erin noted there may be KMS requirements).

Attachments: VH_pricing_model_v3.xlsx, ventura_usage_forecast.csv

Thanks — want to get this out by EOD to meet their PO timeline.
